response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), totals AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes, COUNT(*) as num_observatories FROM telescope_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT tc.observstation, tc.telescope_count, t.total_telescopes, t.num_observatories, CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_telescopes as share, 1.0 / t.num_observatories as avg_share FROM telescope_counts tc CROSS JOIN totals t), above_average AS (SELECT * FROM with_shares WHERE share > avg_share) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as average_excess_over_average FROM above_average
